annotations.target_phrase: Vingtieme Siecle. It was the smallest and most expensive of several floating restaurants
annotations.annotation_text: The hyper-exclusive floating restaurants of Freeside where aristocratic diners consume real agricultural meat ('not vat stuff'), underscoring the extreme class polarization between Sprawl citizens and orbital plutocrats.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 148.

annotations.target_phrase: thick dull grease congealing on the wrinkled lobes, shot through with greenish-purple flashes of pain
annotations.annotation_text: Case's somatic experience of drug comedown and neural overdrive: physiological pain described as tactile neuro-visceral degradation, reinforcing Hayles's thesis that the body ('meat') can never be truly escaped.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 148.
Hayles, N. Katherine. How We Became Posthuman. (1999).
